mapper.select: SELECT s.showtime,s.sale,h.hall_name ,m.langue,m.name,s.id from showtimes s ,hall h ,movie m WHERE s.cinema_id=#{cinemaId} AND s.movie_id=#{movieId} AND s.showdate LIKE concat('%',#{showTime},'%') AND s.hall_id=h.id and m.id=s.movie_id and TIMESTAMP(CONCAT(s.showdate, ' ', s.showtime)) - INTERVAL 15 MINUTE > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

select * from (SELECT s.*, c.name AS cinema_name, m.name AS movie_name, h.hall_name AS hall_name, m.movie_length, DATE_ADD(`showdate` + INTERVAL `showtime` HOUR_SECOND, INTERVAL m.movie_length MINUTE) AS endtime ,account FROM showtimes s JOIN cinema c ON s.cinema_id = c.id JOIN movie m ON s.movie_id = m.id JOIN hall h ON s.hall_id = h.id
and DATE_ADD(`showdate` + INTERVAL `showtime` HOUR_SECOND, INTERVAL m.movie_length MINUTE) < NOW()
and now() BETWEEN DATE_ADD(showdate,INTERVAL showtime HOUR_SECOND) and DATE_ADD(`showdate` + INTERVAL `showtime` HOUR_SECOND, INTERVAL m.movie_length MINUTE)
and DATE_ADD(showdate,INTERVAL showtime HOUR_SECOND) > now()
) t ${ew.customSqlSegment} order by s.id desc

SELECT count(0) FROM cinema c JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT cinema_id FROM showtimes
movie_id = #{mid}
AND showdate like concat('%',#{userDate},'%')
) AS cid ON c.id = cid.cinema_id
and c.brand like concat('%',#{brand},'%')
and c.type like concat('%',#{type},'%')
and c.country like concat('%',#{country},'%')

SELECT showtimes.*,cinema.name cname,movie.name mname,movie.banner,movie.region,movie.movie_length,movie.langue,movie.release_time,hall_name FROM showtimes JOIN cinema on cinema.id = showtimes.cinema_id JOIN movie on movie.id = showtimes.movie_id JOIN hall on hall.id=hall_id ${ew.customSqlSegment}
